commands.command: Audit key-level survival for M139 candidates by joining M136 retained keys, M133 strict selected keys, and M139 strict selected keys.
commands.name: m140_key_survival_audit

commands.command: Prototype the next rollout-aware retention guard/objective from the M140 lost-key audit.
commands.name: m140_rollout_aware_retention_design

decision_rule: Proceed only if the audit identifies a concrete rollout-level signal that explains lost M133 keys better than fixed logprob or fixed action-MSE proxies.
failure_criteria: lost-key analysis again reduces to fixed snippet logprob/action metrics
no actionable rollout-margin or selected-key survival signal is found
proposed repair would require oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: M139 shows even extremely small retained-key action drift can lose strict selected keys. A key-survival audit should identify rollout-level features or guard conditions needed for the next repair.
success_criteria: audit maps M136 retained keys to M133 and M139 strict selected/lost keys
lost keys are explained with rollout margin or selected-key survival evidence
next objective or guard is specified without changing actor inputs
docs, queue, status, and scoreboard are updated
